Messages.Author: Karl Innes
Messages.Body:
faust wrote:
>
> Where can I find the Card Errata for Jyhad/V:TES/Sabbat?
> Cos the other day..while playing, my friend told me that blood to water
> has had its damage changed from 5 to 3. So I would like to check up on
> that.

Untrue, the card Blood to Water has been Errated(sp) to work only at
close range (after range determination but before the strike phase.) the
blood loss due to this card is unchanged (ie. 3 blood at minor 5 at
superior.) You should check Rulemongers page for the most recent rules
and card texts is needed.

Rulemongers Web Page/ card database

http://shangrila.cs.ucdavis.edu:1234/cgi-bin/jol/rulemonger

> Also..the Sabbat version of some cards like "Telepathic Counter" and
> Obedience" have a different text from the V:TES versions. Which is
> right?

Not sure about Telepathic counter but I know someone recently mentioned
in the newsgroup that errata was needed for Obedience in light of the
Sabbat release.

Hope this helps a bit, Karl
